findings.message: Tests are present but unverified, so this is not a missing test. buildItemDetails is the Story's entry point for the planned-tasks table. Its testsReaching list is empty, but board-details.test.ts:12 imports buildItemDetails directly and builds a fixture with taskedSnapshot() at line 20. The graph is missing these test-to-production edges. No build record exists, so whether these tests pass cannot be confirmed.

Tests are present but unverified. taskRows and its private helper itemForPlanId have no testsReaching edges. They are only reachable through buildItemDetails, which board-details.test.ts calls with a tasked snapshot. The host-level helper storyWithPlan at board-host.test.ts:1757, with tasksTable and taskRowsIn, also drives the rendered tasks table. Coverage appears to exist, but because the grounding is missing and there is no build record, the pass state cannot be confirmed.

Tests are present but unverified. taskShortIdOf has an empty testsReaching list, but board-details.test.ts:12 imports it directly, so a test exists. Its pass state is not supported by any build record.

The coverage grounding looks unreliable. No production symbol in board-host.ts, board-details.ts or board-protocol.ts has a single testsReaching edge, including long-standing ones such as createDeliveryBoardHost. Yet the test helpers (detailsSetup, liveBoard, storyWithPlan) clearly drive the host. Empty testsReaching here shows that the index lacks test-to-production edges. It is not evidence of untested code. I have reported no HIGH not-exercised breaches because the evidence does not support them. Coverage for this Story should be confirmed by running the vscode-plugin delivery test suite.
